records.raw_text:
 As per 3 rd Advance Estimates 2025-26, the area sown under the summer crops is 87.26 lakh ha as compared to 83.91 lakh ha during the corresponding period of last year. As compared to previous year, Rice area declined by 0.65 lakh ha whereas, Maize area increased by 2.08 lakh ha, Groundnut by 1.03 lakh ha, Urad by 0.76 lakh ha and Shree Anna by 0.70 lakh ha.
-
As on 01.06.2026, rabi crops harvesting has been completed in all states.
